content: The purpose of the GitLab Offboarding Standards is to specify requirements for offboarding team members from computing resources and data assets to protect customers, team members, and the company from harm [1]. These standards are intended to outline information security measures that protect GitLab assets [1]. [1]

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [GitLab Offboarding Standards > Purpose]
These standards specify requirements related to the offboarding of GitLab team members from all GitLab related computing resources and data assets so as to protect our customers, team members, contractors, company, and other partners from harm caused by both deliberate and inadvertent misuse. Our intention in publishing these standards is to outline information security standards intended to protect GitLab assets.

[2] [GitLab Offboarding Standards > Purpose > Scope]
These standards apply to all GitLab team-members, contractors, advisors, and contracted parties interacting with GitLab computing resources and accessing company or customer data.

| Role  | Responsibility |
|-----------|-----------|
| GitLab Team Members | Responsible for following the requirements in this document |
| People Operations | Responsible for implementing and executing this document |
| People Operations (Code Owners) | Responsible for approving significant changes and exceptions to this document |

[3] [GitLab Offboarding Standards > Purpose > Offboarding Procedure > Notice of Offboarding]
Should the effective date fall on a day which People Operations team is unable to support e.g. a Family and Friends Day or Global Holiday, People Operations Specialist will reach out to the People Business Partner to discuss alternate offboarding options.

[4] [GitLab Offboarding Standards > Purpose > Offboarding Procedure > Offboarding Compliance]
The People Operations Team ensures all offboarding cases are opened within each week of the offboarding effective date (the last day worked).

All offboarding tasks by all Departments need to be completed within 5 days of the offboarding date. For systems that are more critical and time sensitive, these will be completed within the first 24 hours (example 1Password, Slack) by the relevant Departments. Information about application & system deprovisioners can be found on the [Tech Stack](https://techstack.gtlb.com).

To ensure a successful completion of the offboarding case, it is important that all tasks are checked off, whether the system/tool is applicable to the offboarding team member or not. Checking the box indicates one of the following:

- I have revoked team member access to this particular system/tool
- I have checked and this team member was not given access to this particular the system/tool

[5] [GitLab Offboarding > Offboarding Overview > GitLab Alumni Program]
All voluntary exits are eligible to be added to the Slack channel `#gitlab-alumni`, unless otherwise noted. Involuntary exits are not eligible for the alumni channel, unless otherwise noted by Team Member Relations.
The offboarding details provided by the termination transaction in Workday is how eligibility is determined and later shared with IT.

The purpose of this channel is to network and socialize with team members.

Joining the channel is voluntary and subject to GitLab's [Code of Conduct](https://about.gitlab.com/community/contribute/code-of-conduct/).

GitLab, the company, monitors the channel and can remove people from it at their sole discretion.
The GitLab [Code of Business Conduct and Ethics](https://ir.gitlab.com/governance/governance-documents/default.aspx) is enforced in the channel.

[6] [GitLab Offboarding Standards > Purpose > Offboarding Procedure > Creating the Offboarding Case > Creating the Offboarding Case Manually]
**Note:** the steps below reference a `/pops run offboarding` Slack command that generates a GitLab issue. This process predates the move to Compass for offboarding tracking and needs to be confirmed or updated by IT Operations/People Engineering - flagged separately, not yet corrected here.

In the event that the offboarding case is not automatically opened or an urgent case is needed to be opened, the People Operations member can open the offboarding issue manually, by following the steps below:

1. In Slack, go to your profile as if you were going to send a Slack message to yourself. Type the command `/pops run offboarding `.
1. You will be pinged in Slack once the offboarding issue is created, which usually takes 30 seconds or so. The ping will include a link to the offboarding issue and merge request removing from team page.
1. You will need to check the Department, GitLab Email Address and GitLab Handle within the issue are correct.

Question: What is the purpose of the GitLab Offboarding Standards?
